text:
Maya Patel: Quick org update for Platform & Runtime teams — please read 👇
Maya Patel: Effective Mon Apr 7 we're doing a small rotation + backfill: Arun Singh is joining as Senior Platform Engineer (IC), Kelsey Tran is joining as Engineering Manager for Runtime, and Priya Nair will step in as interim Runtime Lead until we hire permanently.
Maya Patel: Reporting: Arun -> Platform (reports to Jorge), Kelsey -> Platform leadership (matrix to Runtime), Priya -> temporarily owns day-to-day for Runtime.
Maya Patel: Action items for folks: 1) @eng-infra please expedite cluster access for Arun; 2) @people-ops will ship laptops and start benefits paperwork for both; 3) teams owning oncall -> please update rotation calendar and migrate any queued runbooks to the Runtime oncall folder.
Maya Patel: Onboarding links: onboarding playbook: https://redwood.example/onboard/platform, docs: https://redwood.example/docs/runtime-team. Buddy assigned: Lizzy Mendoza.
Kelsey Tran: super excited to join — thanks for the warm handoff. I'll set up 1:1 intro slots next week and a weekly Runtime sync. :tada:
Arun Singh: excited to get started. My start date is Mon Apr 7. Quick background: infra + serving at scale (4+ yrs), previous focus on autoscaling and batching. Happy to jump into the backlog.
Priya Nair: happy to take the interim lead role. I'll handle immediate pager & rollout coverage. Can whoever owns the active canary rollout for model-v2 DM me the runbook?
Lizzy Mendoza: Welcome @Arun and @Kelsey! People Ops checklist: laptop + peripherals (3 business days), benefits docs (link will be emailed), expense onboarding. I'm sending calendar invites for orientation and benefits review.
people-ops-bot: Welcome message: "Welcome @Arun Singh and @Kelsey Tran to Redwood Inference! Please complete new-hire forms by EOD Thu."
Jorge Alvarez: Thanks Maya — timeline question: what's the hiring plan for the permanent Runtime Lead? ETA on backfill requisition?
Maya Patel: Good Q Jorge — req is opened today (requisition #PLAT-198). We expect interviews to start in 3 weeks and hire by mid-May if all goes well. Will share hiring rubric and interview slots this afternoon.
Kelsey Tran: For immediate handoffs: can someone prod PR owners on the runtime/kv-cache repo — I can help triage. Also need access to the canary dashboards.
Arun Singh: Can someone add me to #eng-infra and the model-serving doc perms? I'll need SSH + cluster read.
Lizzy Mendoza: @Arun added to onboarding ticket. @eng-infra we flagged this as high priority.
Priya Nair: I'll DM the canary runbook to @Kelsey and @Arun. Also reassigning the next two oncall shifts — ping me if you need swaps.
Jorge Alvarez: noted. Thanks for the quick move. Happy to run first set of shadow sessions with Arun next week.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Small ask: when you meet the new folks, please drop a quick intro in this thread (one-liners are fine). We'll do a formal welcome huddle on Tue 10am PT. :coffee:
